admin_address.description: Administrator's e-mail address for quarantine messages and site-wide policy contact.

admin_name.description: The administrator's name used in notifications.

daemon_address.description: E-mail address from which MIMEDefang quarantine warnings and user notifications appear to come.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for MIMEDefang logging. Enum: daemon, user, mail, syslog, news, local4.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in bytes for SpamAssassin scanning. Calculated from 512 * 1024.
